original_prompt: Generate a clear QR code for http://localhost:8080/Ar_Food_Menu/index.php
enhanced_prompt:
Generate a professional, high-contrast QR code with the following specifications:
- URL to encode: http://localhost:8080/Ar_Food_Menu/index.php
- Size: 1024x1024 pixels (perfect square)
- High contrast: Pure black (#000000) modules on pure white (#FFFFFF) background
- Bold, thick modules for easy scanning
- No text, logos, or decorations inside the QR code
- Clean, minimalist design
- Proper error correction level (Medium or High)
- Suitable for printing on paper or displaying on screen
- Professional appearance for a restaurant application
